name: An empty room
about: A room with a floor, walls and windows, and nothing inside yet.

layers.name: Bottom of the walls
layers.tip: Walls round the edge of the floor, with logs at the corners and a gap for a door.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: Glass for windows at the back and on the sides.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: A full ring of birch planks, right over the door too.

yourTurn.say: Now fill it with things. What kind of room will it be?
ideas: A bedroom: a bed, a lamp and a rug made of carpet.
A kitchen: a smoker, barrels and a table.
A library: bookshelves on every wall.
Room ideas in Builds has lots more.
